title: Sculk Lock
body:
"DO YOU CRAVE THE GRIND?

Do you live for Skyblock efficiency and Tile-lock isolation? Do you dream of total World Domination?

The S.C.U.L.K. Infiltration Taskforce wants YOU.

You have been deployed to a newly discovered cuboid planet with one objective: Complete Assimilation. Due to biological constraints, your feet must never leave the sculk. The local atmosphere is hostile—H2O is a corrosive acid that falls from the clouds and fills the oceans.

MISSION SPECS:

ACOUSTIC TRAVERSAL: If you aren't on sculk, you aren't safe.

TOTAL LIQUIDATION: Kill the natives to spread the glorious sculk and expand your empire.

ADVANCED ARSENAL: Master over 100 new recipes and a completely overhauled enchanting system.
The planet is resisting. Break it. S.P.R.E.A.D. the infection. Join Sculk Lock today."
